title: TabNSM: Neural Sparse Mixer for Tabular Regression
abstract: arXiv:2608.18026v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large-scale, high-dimensional tabular regression remains challenging: tree-based models are robust but lack end-to-end representation learning, while deep models enable flexible feature learning but often incur costly interaction modeling and sensitivity to noisy or redundant features. We propose TabNSM, a scalable regression framework that extends our earlier sparse-attention and mixer architectures. At its core, the Adaptive Sparse Interaction Module (ASIM) integrates foreground feature discovery, sparse local interaction encoding, and Feature-Token Mixing, providing near-linear complexity under fixed sparse configurations. translated_title: TabNSM：用于表格回归的神经稀疏混合器
translated_abstract: 大规模、高维表格回归仍然具有挑战性：基于树的模型稳健但缺乏端到端的表示学习，而深度模型能实现灵活的特征学习，但常常导致高昂的交互建模成本以及对噪声或冗余特征的敏感性。我们提出TabNSM，一个可扩展的回归框架，它扩展了我们早期的稀疏注意力和混合器架构。其核心是自适应稀疏交互模块（ASIM），它集成了前景特征发现、稀疏局部交互编码和特征-令牌混合，在固定稀疏配置下提供接近线性的复杂度。对于回归，TabNSM引入了三个互补组件：用于渐进预测细化的多阶段回归头；GridLoss，一种有序感知的软分箱目标，将目标结构纳入表示学习；以及RISE（基于误差的重加权实例采样），一种难度感知的采样策略，以提升对困难样本的处理。
tldr: 该论文提出了TabNSM框架，通过自适应稀疏交互模块和多组件回归策略，在保持接近线性复杂度的同时，有效提升了高维表格回归任务的性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TabNSM, a scalable regression framework with an Adaptive Sparse Interaction Module and multi-component strategies, achieving near-linear complexity while improving performance on high-dimensional tabular regression.
